objective: Every MiOS image is one equivalent MiOS system: the Codespaces devcontainer, the Claude Code cloud environment, MiOS-DEV and the OCI image load the same full MiOS ([profiles] phases and components), so opening the devcontainer on GitHub Codespaces loads an entire MiOS system for developing MiOS within itself; once the devcontainer image works, a Claude Code cloud container built to its specs debugs it live and the deploy loop repeats until MiOS is developed. -dev-loop stays project-agnostic and MiOS works without -dev-loop.
